import { Component, OnInit } from '@angular/core'; import { ActivatedRoute } from '@angular/router'; import { CommonModule } from '@angular/common'; import { FileService } from 'src/app/core/services/file.service'; import { OrderByDatePipe } from 'src/app/core/order-by-date.pipe'; @Component({ selector: 'app-student-files', standalone: true, imports: [CommonModule,OrderByDatePipe], templateUrl: './student-files.component.html', styleUrls: ['./student-files.component.scss'] }) export class StudentFilesComponent implements OnInit { classId!: number; files: any[] = []; loading = true; constructor(private route: ActivatedRoute, private fileService: FileService) {} ngOnInit() { this.classId = +this.route.snapshot.params['id']; this.fileService.getFilesByClass(this.classId).subscribe({ next: res => { this.files = res; this.loading = false; }, error: err => { console.error('Erreur:', err); this.loading = false; } }); } getFilesByType(type: string) { return this.files.filter(f => this.getTypeLabel(f.type) === type); } getTypeLabel(type: any): string { if (typeof type === 'number') { switch (type) { case 0: return 'Cours'; case 1: return 'TD'; case 2: return 'TP'; default: return 'Autre'; } } return type; } }
